audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 3 and 4-5 were scored Gangplank while whys[2] says 'I keep the wave back and only trade Parrrley pokes when his Q is down' and whys[3] says the stage 'pulls the lane back to even'. Level 6 was scored Wukong while whys[4] and spikes[2] both call it 'roughly a coin flip'.
audit.why: 51.75% over 1258 games with a lane described as clawing back to even and only tipping at your Sheen item. The packet chart (Wukong, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank) matches the prose row for row.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the packet chart, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's spike rows named no ability of either champion — phases[3] and phases[4] were the generic 'lane-control window' and 'Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in' boilerplate.
audit.why: The real level 4-5 change is the second E point letting you place a keg behind your own line so Nimbus Strike has no clean entry, and the real level 6 change is Cyclone versus Cannon Barrage. Neither was on the page.
audit.corrected: Both written into phases[3].why and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] is titled 'Q-cleanse his slows' and breakdown.cooldowns says 'Cleanse the slow' on the Nimbus Strike line — Gangplank's cleanse is W, Remove Scurvy, not Parrrley. Separately, the clone interaction (the single most punishing thing in this lane for a barrel champion) appeared only in wants.foe[1] and mid, never in the trade rules or don'ts.
audit.why: Detonating a keg chain onto Warrior Trickster's decoy wastes the whole zone and leaves the real Wukong free. That belongs in tradeBad and dontsFull, and it was not there.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy named as the cleanse; the clone bait written into tradeGood, tradeBad and dontsFull[0].d; Crushing Blow's armour shred into dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: All three content paragraphs are in FIRST PERSON — 'lowers my armor', 'This is where I claw it back', 'Once my Sheen/Essence Reaver lands I flip this'.
audit.why: Breaks the site's second-person coaching voice.
audit.corrected: Converted to second person at the same length, with the Cyclone-cleanse sentence left semantically untouched (see notes).

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup asserts in four places (whys[4], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[2]) that Remove Scurvy 'cleanses the airborne' from Cyclone.
audit.why: The enemyKit for Wukong is null in this brief, so there is no authority here for Cyclone's CC type, and Riot's Remove Scurvy text says only 'cure crowd control effects' with nothing about knockup eligibility. I could not verify it, so I did not restate, strengthen or remove it.
audit.corrected: Left as-is and escalated — see questionsForUser.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Wukong must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online but Nimbus Strike still punishes an over-step — keep the wave back and poke only when his Q is down.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Second Q and E points let you chain Parrrley-into-keg as he walks up, and a keg behind your own line denies his E entry. Back to even.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Wukong's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Cyclone is a real engage and Cannon Barrage zones it — 6 is a coin flip, not a loss. Never spend a detonation on his clone.

edits.before: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Wukong steps to farm, and orange away whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Wukong steps to farm, and never spend the detonation on his clone.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Detonating your keg chain on Warrior Trickster's decoy — the zone is gone and the real Wukong is on you.

edits.before: His engage dash. Cleanse the slow. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage dash. Bait it out, then commit — it is his only clean entry.

edits.before: Wukong wastes Nimbus Strike — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy is your cleanse, not Parrrley — hold W for his commit.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster's clone eats a detonation you can't get back — check for damage.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow shreds your armour before the empowered auto lands.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike into Crushing Blow is the burst — space so his dash has no target to enter on.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his — Wukong's Crushing Blow lowers my armor and lands an empowered crit-auto, his passive Stone Skin hands him free resists standing next to me, and I have one low-HP barrel on a long cooldown that he can pop before it ever arms. Don't place a keg in melee expecting it to live; set it back behind the wave and last-hit with the tip of Parrrley. Respect his Nimbus Strike dash — if he E's in with Q ready I lose that short trade every time, so I give ground and farm safe.

Respect his Nimbus Strike dash — if he E's in with Q ready you lose that short trade every time, so give ground and farm safe.

edits.before: This is where I claw it back to even. With a second Q and E point I land Parrrley-into-keg poke as he walks up to farm, and his clone (Warrior Trickster) is the trap — don't blow my keg detonation on the decoy or I waste the whole zone. At 6 his Cyclone knockup looks scary, but Remove Scurvy cleanses the airborne and heals off my missing HP, so I cleanse on the lift, right-click out of the spin, and walk away. Bait his E-dash before I ever commit a chain.

edits.before: Once my Sheen/Essence Reaver lands I flip this — empowered Parrrley plus a full barrel chain bursts him before his W clone or E can reset, and Cannon Barrage zones him off objectives and sieges from across the map. He builds bruiser resists, so I lean into the keg burst instead of trying to out-auto him through Stone Skin. He stays even and item-dependent rather than a true hard scaler, so as long as I survived the early I own the back half — just never face-check for the clone near objectives.

notes: The brief's enemyKit for Wukong is null, so no cooldown numbers, ranges or CC types could be sourced for this matchup and none were written. Every edit here is either an enum flip, a voice fix, or a restatement of an interaction the content layer already carried. Packet suspect name 'Use Warrior Trickster' is a false positive. The Cyclone/Remove Scurvy cleanse claim is escalated rather than changed.
